notes.title: 9/1 Update
notes.content:
New Feature
[list]
[*] We have implmented a new way of how skills are upgraded in game.
[*] Now skills can be upgraded at the end of every level (with a cost), with a new UI showing you all potential upgrades. So you can better plan your build.
[*] The old skill upgrade altars are changed to a more rare appearance, where you can get a skill upgrade for free.
[/list]

Improvements:
[list]
[*] We have made some changes to sound effects of sword weapons.
[*] We have implemented a new rendering path for visual effect when hitting enemies.
[/list]

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue causing a few enemy skills not able to hit player.
[*] Fixed the confirmation window display when purchasing items.
[*] Demon's sprint skill can now change direction while running.
[/list]

[*] We have implemented a new rendering path for visual effect when hitting enemies.

notes.title: 8/20 Update Notes
notes.content:
Content Tweak:
[list]
[*] We have lowered the cost of unlocking "Scout", for an earlier ranged character experience.
[*] We have moved relic reward from end of branches to the end of main path.
[*] Blacksmith in Village no longer sells legendary items.
[*] We have tweaked attributes of a few equipments.
[*] We have tweaked controlling skill durations of a few mobs.
[/list]

Issue Fixes：
[list]
[*] We have re-balanced all skills with "counter strike" feature. It was way too over powered.
[*] We have fixed a few activation issued of armour sets.
[/list]

Upcoming Changes：
[list]
[*] We are re-working the skill upgrade mechanism, for a more flexible and friendly build experience. 
[/list]

notes.title: Game update: 20201012
notes.content:
1, Player now deals 25% more damage than before, while enemy HP gets a near 20% nerf
2, Enemy now deals 20% less damage to player than before
3, Dodge cooldown is now 1.8s instead of 2.5s, we didn't cancel dodge cooldown due to its invulnerbility, suggestions of canceling dodge cooldown might be viable, but if executed, must be accompanied by canceling the invulnerbility of dodge, we are still thinking about this.
4, Player gets 50% more soul tone than before, makes grinding easier.

We expect the reduction of initial difficulty + grinding efficiency improvement would vastly ease the burden in our game experience.

Your kind suggestions are very much appreciated! Thank you very much!
